messages:
jamal: Heads-up — trying to press the prod deploy for the 23:00 UTC window but my `deployer` role failed JIT. Anyone available to approve a one-off?
deploy-bot: Deploy request queued for jamal. Requires "prod-press" entitlement. Please request via `/request-elev jamal 30m`.
maria: @jamal did you request via the portal? I can approve if you have manager signoff. Need a short release note and rollback plan.
jamal: Yep, release note in repo: `release-notes.md` -> "fix: kv-cache spillover". Rollback plan: roll back to v1.4.8, run smoke + quick perf checks.
dennis: What's the MFA state on your account? If your MFA rotated we block token minting.
jamal: MFA shows active. Error was `403: temporary-privilege-not-found` when deploy-bot tried to mint token.
sre-oncall: Looking at audit — deploy-bot log shows `token-issue-failed: owner-mismatch` for jamal @4979998888.
maria: That usually means jamal is missing the `release-press` or `oncall-press` group. Can you run `identityctl whoami`?
jamal: Ran it: `groups: developers, deployer, temp-sudo` — no `release-press`.
lisa: @maria FYI our policy is only `release-press` or delegated `oncall-press` get JIT. jamal isn't in either.
jamal: Got it. Can someone delegate oncall-press for tonight? Need 45m to cover the push.
maria: I can grant a delegate but need @dennis to ack rollback is pinned and tested.
dennis: Ack. I reviewed the rollback steps in the doc and verified smoke tests. +1 to delegate for 45m.
maria: Delegation granted to jamal for 45m — `delegate-id: del-2026-03-20-497999` :lock: (audit recorded).
deploy-bot: Delegation applied. Jamal may press within the window. Reminder: all prod deploys must use `--pin-version` and include a release note link.
jamal: Thanks. Quick question — pin to `v1.4.9` or `v1.4.9-rc1`?
maria: Pin to `v1.4.9` (stable). If canary looks good we can roll forward later.
jamal: Starting canary: `deploy prod --pin-version v1.4.9 --notes https://git/release/234`
deploy-bot: Canary started: 10 pods, gradual rollout with 5m intervals. Monitor `console/releases/v1.4.9`.
sre-oncall: Watching metrics — if error rate >2% or CPU throttling spikes in gorouter we rollback.
lisa: If rollback needed, run `deploy rollback --to v1.4.8 --fast` and ping #incidents.
jamal: Canary at +3m looks healthy. No errors reported. :thumbsup:
dennis: Thanks all. Paste the final prod push link here when the full rollout is complete for postmortem notes.
